definitions.explanation: Bite-sized pieces of meat (usually chicken) marinated, coated with flour or starch, and deep-fried.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏|とり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{唐揚|からあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{唐揚|からあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧。
examples.english: Squeeze lemon on the fried chicken.
examples.notes: A common but sometimes controversial practice

notes:
Also written as {空揚|からあ}げ or から{揚|あ}げ. The {唐|から} refers to China/foreign style, though the dish is distinctly Japanese.

Preparation typically involves:
1. Marinating in ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧, ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧, ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧, ⟦にんにく→大蒜：05190_ninniku⟧
2. Coating with ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧ or ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧
3. Deep-frying until golden and crispy

{大分|おおいた}{県|けん}{中津|なかつ}{市|し} is famous as a karaage town. The debate over whether to squeeze lemon on shared karaage (⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦{論争|ろんそう}→論争：03786_ronsou⟧) is a common topic.

Similar: ⟦{竜田揚|たつたあ}げ→竜田揚げ：28721_tatsutaage⟧ (uses potato starch only, often with soy sauce marinade).
